decision: principal proposes breaking apart leverage and positions in Parametric ahead of the forecast 2027 drawdown
endorsed_in_part: YES on the LEVERAGE. NOT AUTOMATICALLY on the positions - the two have opposite economics.

the_asymmetry.leverage: cutting gross exposure costs ~ZERO tax, removes the forced-deleverage tail, and KEEPS the tax-alpha engine running. This is a free action given a p=0.45 break call and should be done regardless of what the positions do.
the_asymmetry.positions: selling appreciated direct-index lots realizes gains at ~35% blended. Exit-toll math: expected loss avoided = p_break(0.45) x modal drawdown(22.5%) = 10.1% of position value. Tax cost = embedded_gain_fraction x 35%. BREAKEVEN AT ~29% EMBEDDED GAIN. Above that the toll exceeds the risk it avoids - and that assumes PERFECT re-entry; late or never re-entering drives avoided-loss toward zero while the tax stays permanent.

ranked_tools_cheapest_first.note: a drawdown makes direct indexing MORE valuable, not less - do not exit the machine right before its best year

principal_correction_20260803.point: 'we'll have losses to sell against' - CORRECT and it materially changes the recommendation
principal_correction_20260803.why_it_changes_things: capital losses offset capital GAINS dollar-for-dollar with NO cap (the $3k limit is only against ordinary income). Every $1 harvested = $1 of Parametric gain realized tax-free. The ~29% embedded-gain breakeven I derived assumed an UNSHELTERED sale - with a loss bank the exit toll goes to zero up to the bank's size, so the breakeven test applies only to the UNSHELTERED excess.
principal_correction_20260803.hard_constraint: losses carry FORWARD, never backward. A 2027 loss cannot offset a 2026 gain. Gains must be realized in the SAME tax year as the losses, or after them. SEQUENCING RULE: harvest first (or same calendar year), then realize the matching Parametric gain. Never sell appreciated lots in a year whose losses are not yet banked.

capacity_schedule.note: only the GAIN portion needs shelter, not the proceeds - at 40% embedded gain, $1.4M of losses unwinds ~$3.5M of position value

principal_correction_20260803.self_solving_property: if the break HAPPENS the harvest explodes (every name red) while Parametric's embedded gains shrink - de-risking gets cheap exactly when it is most wanted; if the break does NOT happen you unwound slowly and tax-free at the loss bank's pace and kept the upside. Low regret in both branches.
principal_correction_20260803.revised_recommendation: UNWIND ON THE LOSS SCHEDULE, not on a fear schedule. (1) cut leverage now - still free and still first; (2) size each year's Parametric sale to that year's BANKED losses; (3) hedge the unsheltered residual with the XSP program rather than paying tax to exit it; (4) accelerate only if a lot's embedded gain is under ~29%, which clears the toll test unsheltered.
principal_correction_20260803.new_dependency: this makes the $5M deployment pace the RATE LIMITER on de-risking Parametric - another argument for not letting the cash idle, and for the long-only tax-managed DI residual (which harvests) over SGOV (which cannot)
principal_correction_20260803.open_question_for_principal: GOOGL is flagged no-harvest by explicit instruction. With a loss bank the same logic would make trimming it cheap too - is that instruction absolute, or was it conditioned on the tax cost that the loss bank now removes?

timing_ruling_20260803.why_it_is_right: 2026's residual harvest capacity is ~$60k against a book that only began deploying in August - selling appreciated Parametric this year would be almost entirely UNSHELTERED and would hit the ~29% breakeven test naked. The loss bank does not exist yet; 2027 is the first year it does.
what_still_happens_in_2026: CUT THE LEVERAGE - unchanged, still free, still first; it does not depend on the loss bank and it is the tail our own board forecasts
DEPLOY - every dollar that reaches courted names creates the 2027 basis; deployment pace IS the 2027 unwind capacity
harvest what genuinely qualifies: PL (-$2.7k, thesis impaired) is the only current position where the sale stands on its own merits; everything else is FX noise on names we want
pull the five missing Parametric numbers (size, embedded-gain-by-lot, levered vs long-only, tech concentration, terms) so the 2027 lot list can be built in advance
build the wash-sale map: Parametric holdings x IBKR book - a 2027 Parametric sale is void if we buy the same name within 31 days
timing_ruling_20260803.execution_cadence_from_2027: Q4 TRUE-UP. Losses arrive unpredictably (they appear when things fall); the year's realized loss total is only knowable around November. So: bank losses opportunistically all year, then in Nov/Dec size the Parametric sale to the CONFIRMED loss total and execute before Dec 31. Never front-run the bank.
timing_ruling_20260803.the_2027_collision_noted: 2027 is simultaneously the first unwind year AND the board's modal break year (AI-BREAK p=0.45 by 2027-12-31). If the break lands mid-2027 we would be unwinding INTO it - which the self-solving property handles (gains shrink, harvest explodes) but which makes the Q4 cadence more valuable, not less: by November the year's reality is known and the sale is sized to facts rather than forecasts.
timing_ruling_20260803.one_open_instruction: GOOGL no-harvest: still flagged for the principal - with a 2027 loss bank the trim becomes cheap; awaiting whether that instruction was absolute or tax-conditioned

RESOLUTION: sequence it - run the shorts hard through Dec-31 to bank 2026 losses against the $5M gain, THEN cut gross in early 2027 before the modal break window. The de-risking is a 2027 action anyway (per the principal's own timing ruling); the harvesting is a 2026 deadline. They do not actually conflict once ordered correctly.

APP_DOUBLE_COUNT_BUG_20260803.trigger: principal: 'the app says a different number - 645.0K long losses and 597.9K short losses against 173.2K gains'
APP_DOUBLE_COUNT_BUG_20260803.finding: THE APP IS DOUBLE-COUNTING. /gainloss/summary (main.py:355) sums the RAW gainloss table with no dedup. CCAR002X files are MONTH-TO-DATE snapshots, so the SAME closed lot is re-reported in every subsequent file - up to 21 times. The table's UNIQUE key is (source_file, source_row), which permits exactly this duplication by design.

evidence.repetition_histogram: 1520 lots appear once, 515 appear 5x, 11 appear 10x, 2 appear 21x
evidence.example: the 542-row July MTD block is present in at least 3 separate source files (06Jul, 14Jul, 21Jul/28Jul/31Jul)
